chapter: Chicago and New York with Louis Armstrong, 1925-30
title: Zutty would have quit any band to play with Louis; Louis's devotion
summary: Marge says Zutty would have given up anything to play with Louis, who loved him back and nursed him after his stroke, saying he'd kill himself if Zutty died.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: He always had that you know. Now Zutty, Zutty had his bands and everything. His little outfits you know. He had, but he would have quit any of them to play with Louis Armstrong. Zutty just loved Louis. He just loved Louis. He wanted to play with Louis. And he'd have given up anything to play with Louis.
That's very sad you know really.
Well I suppose that, you know it's human mature.

And God Louis loved Zutty. Now when Zutty got sick Louis came here, and everything and was carrying on something awful and told me, Marge I believe if Zutty would die, I think I'd kill myself. That's what he told me. He said, I'd commit suicide if anything happened. And when he looked at that picture where 'May we Never Part', he said, well, we picking up from where we left off. And the way he

bathed Zutt y and wheeled him out to the house like Zutt y was a piece of gold. And tried to shave him, tried to do everything. Because he knew Zutt y loved him and he loved Zutt y. But he let that.......

Well you know what I mean, like Zutt y told him, business is one thing and friendship is another. And he couldn't make all this money and I guess he had to go with Louis Russel's band just like it was.
Yes well you know when you look back on things you can see what was right and what was wrong. But I mean at the time, now who was Louis married to then?
Well what influence would she have had?

None, Icause she loved us. Oh she was for us, yes indeed. We were a foursome. Talk about having fun together. And when they'd come to New York we'd hang out together. They lived at the Hall where we lived around the corner, had our in those own apartment and everything and boy.......
